about: Descriptive tags for each corpus film, chosen from the fixed vocabulary below. Written by an AI model (Claude) on 2026-11-20 from its knowledge of the films, not by a person and not from TMDB. The vocabulary was designed without sight of the evaluation moods. Films added later by scripts/grow_corpus.py were tagged the same way in batches (150 on 2026-11-20); any listed under 'predicted' carry machine-predicted tags that nobody has checked. See docs/evaluation-baseline.md and docs/corpus-growth.md.
